title: First Shot
description: A military rebel group resurfaces with a vengeance to assassinate the president for the death of their brothers. Agent McGregor, the head of the Secret Service, tries to prevent attacks on the president's life.

title: The Marine 6: Close Quarters
description: Jake Carter and another former Marine, Luke Trapper, join forces to rescue a kidnapped girl from a gang of international criminals.

title: Wings of Courage
description: A pilot (Craig Sheffer) crashes during a terrible storm, walks away, and gets lost in the Andes Mountains.

title: Birdy
description: A Vietnam veteran helps his bird-obsessed boyhood buddy in a psychiatric hospital.

title: Ike: Countdown to D-Day
description: Gen. Dwight D. Eisenhower (Tom Selleck) faces monumental decisions in the 90 days leading to the Allied invasion of Normandy in 1944.

title: Bad Country
description: After arresting a contract killer, a Louisiana detective tries to convince him to become an informant in an attempt to bring down the South's most powerful criminal organization.

title: The Mask of Zorro
description: The fabled avenger trains an uncouth protégé to drive a Spanish tyrant out of California once and for all.

title: That's My Boy
description: A groom's (Andy Samberg) world comes crashing down when his estranged father (Adam Sandler) -- who is desperate to reconnect with his son -- shows up on the eve of the young man's wedding.

title: Jack and Jill
description: The life of a successful, happy ad executive descends into chaos when his needy, passive-aggressive twin sister (also Sandler) makes her annual Thanksgiving visit.

title: Chances Are
description: A reincarnated man (Robert Downey Jr.) returns 23 years later to his wife (Cybill Shepherd), their daughter and his former best friend (Ryan O'Neal).

title: Against All Odds
description: A Los Angeles bookie (James Woods) hires an ex-football star (Jeff Bridges) to find his runaway mistress (Rachel Ward) in Mexico.

title: No Mercy
description: A Chicago detective (Richard Gere) flees through a bayou, handcuffed to the Cajun mistress (Kim Basinger) of a ponytailed crime lord (Jeroen Krabbé).

title: Gloria
description: A street-toughened woman (Sharon Stone) goes on the run with a 7-year-old boy (Jean-Luke Figueroa) whose parents were killed by mobsters.

title: Home Invasion
description: A mother (Veronica Hamel) and daughter (Bonnie Root) try to outwit robbers holding them and three friends captive.

title: Blue-Eyed Butcher
description: Susan Wright (Sara Paxton) stands trial for the murder of her husband (Justin Bruening) in their Texas home.

title: The River Murders
description: A homicide detective investigating a series of murders becomes the prime suspect when the FBI uncovers his close ties to all the victims.

title: Maximum Risk
description: Federal agents and the Russian Mafia chase a French policeman (Jean-Claude Van Damme) on a mission in New York City.

title: Desperate Measures
description: To save his terminally ill son, a San Francisco policeman (Andy Garcia) arranges for a sociopathic killer (Michael Keaton) to donate bone marrow.

title: Mortal Thoughts
description: Best friends (Demi Moore, Glenne Headly) in New Jersey get in trouble after one's rotten husband (Bruce Willis) goes too far.

title: Obsessed
description: A successful, happily married executive (Idris Elba) becomes the object of unwanted affection from a temp worker (Ali Larter) at his company.

title: It Could Happen to You
description: A New York policeman (Nicolas Cage) keeps his promise to split a $4 million lottery prize with a waitress (Bridget Fonda), but his wife objects.

title: Crazy in Alabama
description: An eccentric (Melanie Griffith) kills her abusive husband and heads to Hollywood to pursue her dreams.

title: Stealing Harvard
description: A nitwit (Tom Green) persuades his down-to-earth friend (Jason Lee) to commit robbery to pay for college tuition.

title: Whatever It Takes
description: Two teenagers use contrived e-mails, phone calls and double dates to win their dream girls (Marla Sokoloff, Jodi Lyn O'Keefe).

title: The Waterdance
description: Paralyzed by a hiking accident, a young writer (Eric Stoltz) struggles to adjust among other men in a hospital ward.

title: Finding Graceland
description: A man (Johnathon Schaech) meets a Marilyn Monroe impersonator (Bridget Fonda) while traveling with an aging hitchhiker (Harvey Keitel) who thinks he is Elvis.

title: Nothing in Common
description: A yuppie adman (Tom Hanks) faces his parents' (Jackie Gleason, Eva Marie Saint) separation and his father's need for a major operation.

title: Running With Scissors
description: A man looks back on his unusual childhood, his mentally ill mother (Annette Bening) and her unorthodox therapist (Brian Cox).

title: Relative Chaos
description: Encouraged by his girlfriend (Charisma Carpenter), a man (Christopher Gorham) joins his two siblings for their father's (Terry Bradshaw) weeklong event of competitive games.

title: The Green Hornet
description: The heir (Seth Rogen) to a newspaper fortune joins forces with a resourceful company employee (Jay Chou) to bring a powerful Los Angeles crime lord to justice.

title: Close Encounters of the Third Kind: The Director's Cut
description: An Indiana lineman (Richard Dreyfuss) and other UFO-sighters, beleaguered by earlier incidents, finally have documented contact with space aliens.

title: Battle: Los Angeles
description: After the world's great cities fall, a Marine staff sergeant (Aaron Eckhart) and his platoon make a last stand against alien invaders.

title: Hardwired
description: A man (Cuba Gooding Jr.) turns to hackers for help after he awakes from a car accident and learns he has a computer chip implanted in his brain.

title: Air
description: When breathable air becomes nonexistent, two engineers (Norman Reedus, Djimon Hounsou) must guard the remaining survivors who reside in a controlled state of suspended animation.

title: Bermuda Triangle
description: A physician's (Sam Behrens) family is stranded on an island community of survivors presumed lost in the infamous Bermuda Triangle.

title: Facing the Giants
description: A Christian high-school football coach (Alex Kendrick) inspires the players on his losing team through his steadfast belief in God.

title: Wild America
description: Three Arkansas brothers (Jonathan Taylor Thomas, Devon Sawa, Scott Bairstow) travel across the country filming animals in their habitats during the summer of 1967.

title: Jack and Jill
description: The life of a successful, happy ad executive descends into chaos when his needy, passive-aggressive twin sister (also Sandler) makes her annual Thanksgiving visit.

title: Last Action Hero
description: A golden ticket, a memento handed down from Houdini, puts a boy in the middle of a Hollywood superstar's lavish and secretive world.

title: Open Season
description: Stranded in the wilderness, a mule deer (Ashton Kutcher) and a domesticated bear (Martin Lawrence) try to make their way back to the safety of a town preserve before a hunter catches them.

title: Annie
description: Daddy Warbucks (Albert Finney) protects little orphan Annie (Aileen Quinn) from Miss Hannigan (Carol Burnett) and crooks in Depression-era New York.
